# anthropic_spend_limit (Data Source)

Reads one spend limit row in a Claude Enterprise organization by id. Requires `enterprise_api_key`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_spend_limit" "example" {
  id = "spl_01ExampleSpendLimitId0000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Spend limit id (`spl_...`).

### Read-Only

- `amount` (String) Cap in minor units (cents) as a string; null when unlimited.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 currency code.
- `period` (String) `daily`, `weekly` or `monthly`.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `user_id` (String) User the limit applies to; null for non-user scopes.
